Allowed origins (`worker/src/index.ts`, `app.use('*', cors({ origin: ... }))`, ~lines 20–30):

- `http://localhost:4200` (exact match)
- any `*.pages.dev` subdomain
- any `*.workers.dev` subdomain

To add a new custom domain, edit the `origin` function in `worker/src/index.ts`, adding a check like `origin === 'https://yourdomain.com'` (or an `.endsWith('.yourdomain.com')` check for subdomains) inside the existing `if (...)` condition before `return origin;`. Since Hono's CORS `origin` array option only matches exact strings (no wildcards), this function-based approach must be used — see `docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md` §4 (CORS).
